objective.title: Issue #69 (MR67V-001): pin the tools and disallowedTools values of the read-only agents in check_pack.py

nodes.title: check_pack.py: pinned raw tools and disallowedTools values of dev-explorer, dev-reviewer and dev-security-reviewer; the three files must exist in exact case; a size limit for them and a normalized-name collision check; negative tests; FU-033 tests; records
dod: check_pack.py fails when a read-only agent file is missing, or when its raw tools or disallowedTools line differs from the pinned string (a space-separated write tool, '*', a specifier, an added tool, a removed or changed disallowedTools); each case has a negative test that fails when the pin check is removed; the current tree passes; the independent review and the Security Diff Scan find no open MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX
